failed_gates: 4 CRITICAL fact(s) CONTRADICTED (H4, H5, H16, H17)
summary: All three press stages are covered with every golden shut height, stroke, pressure and dimension correctly bound to its machine, so the process content is close to complete. It fails because the header revision (00 vs 01) and dates (11/11/17 vs 22.02.2020) are wrong, and because it adds many actionable specs that are not in the golden: min shut heights 795/760/750 mm, D 513, top liner and cushion pin sizes, the F-PRD-17, RG-PRD-01, F-QMS-6 and F-DVP-29 form references, hourly check frequencies, and new rework procedures. The rework table also gives different actions for dent and hole/slot defects, and drops the thickness rework row.
